notes.title: 10.30 Update
notes.content:
What's New:
1. Change the fishing method and use the mouse instead of the keyboard
2. You might catch a treasure chest
3. Fish can be released at any time, no longer limiting the growth value
4. If the achievement is not unlocked, the current progress is displayed
5. Adjust the sea and fish tank to a dynamic scene
